title: lepidolopsis pseudoachillea
intro: Lepidolopsis pseudoachillea, commonly known as the pseudo-achillea or pseudo-Achillea, is a plant species in the family Amaranthaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine in Kazakhstan and is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Lepidolopsis pseudoachillea has been traditionally used to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and skin disorders, and its therapeutic actions include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Lepidolopsis pseudoachillea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
